proposed.explanation:
TMGH's FY2025 results show strong, accelerating growth: gross profit rose ~49% year-over-year (from 14.00 B EGP to 20.86 B EGP), net income attributable to parent shareholders jumped ~59% (from 9.03 B to 14.38 B EGP), and EPS grew from 4.38 to 6.98 EGP. At the current price of 82.50 EGP, the implied P/E is roughly 11.8×, which is reasonable for a company growing earnings at nearly 60%. Total equity expanded ~21% to 157.7 B EGP, suggesting the balance sheet is strengthening alongside the income statement.

For your profile—aggressive growth mandate, 10+ year horizon, no liquidity needs, and high loss tolerance—allocating to a high-growth name at a single-digit-plus P/E is well-suited. I recommend buying 254 shares of TMGH (cost 20,955 EGP), which keeps TMGH at ~49.9% of your total portfolio value (42,040 EGP), just under the 50% diversification cap. Your remaining cash will be 19,045 EGP, and your existing 100 EFID shares (2,040 EGP) stay untouched.

Caveats and risks: (1) The evidence covers only one fiscal year; a single year of strong growth does not guarantee continuation. (2) No data on debt levels, free cash flow, dividend policy, or competitive moat is provided, so the quality of earnings and sustainability of growth cannot be fully assessed. (3) There is no evidence on EFID, so I am neither adding to nor reducing that position. (4) Egyptian-listed equities carry country-specific risks (currency, regulation, liquidity) that are not captured here. This is guidance, not a guarantee of returns; the stock could decline materially.
